## Completed behaviour (PRO-13–PRO-18 + max-width 1420)

- **PRO-07/PRO-14/13**: `--maxw: 1420px`; home product sections use a four-column `.home-products` grid (falls back to 2 at ≤900px); blog keeps three cards with `aspect-ratio: 2/1`. Default `featured` topped up to four already-published models; `sale` left as an honest 2-item discounted list (no new SKUs/prices).
- **PRO-15**: product page has a gallery with 2–3 genuinely distinct local views (side/drivetrain/cockpit; frames 2; parts 1); single-image models still open the large dialog but have no pager/thumbs; right column = brand/name, stars + `(average) - count Ratings` for the whole model, colour/size row, price/stock row, Add to cart (one unit)/Go to cart; no description/quantity at top; heart top-right over the image; Description/Specifications/Reviews/Manufacturer tabs (sizes in Description for all categories).
- **PRO-16**: catalog card heart is a separate control top-right inside the image (never nested in the product link); a successful save (including deferred guest confirm) opens the Russian popup «Товар добавлен в избранное» with «перейти в избранное» / «продолжить покупки» and a close X; guest cancel saves nothing.
- **PRO-17**: model-level reviews (never SKU) with signed-in/1–5/title validation, optional description, 5-per-page numbered pagination, aggregate across all reviews, `0 Ratings` when empty, seeded ≥6 on `gravel-01`, escaped text, persisted, migration hardens malformed data without overwriting valid custom reviews; successful submit returns to Reviews page 1.
- **PRO-18**: checkbox filter groups with model counts, OR within / AND across, one-SKU conjunction retained, Show more >4 (selected hidden values stay open after back/reload), legacy single links preserved; numeric GBP Max price (legacy `?priceMax=100000` pence still works); finder dropdown unchanged.
